basics.name: Jiahui Huan
basics.label: M.S. Student in Robotics Engineering
basics.summary: Researcher interested in robotic manipulation, imitation learning, 3D vision, and data-efficient robot learning.

education.institution: University of Science and Technology Beijing

publications.name: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
publications.summary: Third author. RealDexUMI is a wearable interface for collecting deployment-aligned dexterous-manipulation data, validated across eight real-robot tasks.

portfolio.name: ROBOCON 2025: Wheel-Legged Dunking Robot
portfolio.description: Led the design and iteration of a 1.5 m wheel-legged dunking robot. Developed SLIP-based jump planning and VMC-based landing control; the robot achieved a 40 cm vertical jump and over 95% dunking success in 100+ fixed-point tests.

portfolio.name: ROBOCON 2024: Autonomous Grain Collection and Placement Robot
portfolio.description: Led end-to-end development of an autonomous grain-tracking, grasping, and placement robot with a 3-DOF arm, four-swerve chassis, depth camera, LiDAR, and encoders.

portfolio.name: One-Shot Demo Synthesis for Robot Imitation Learning
portfolio.description: A data-efficient robotic manipulation system that synthesizes demonstrations from one teleoperated example and trains 3D Diffusion Policy models for simulated and real-robot deployment.
